next.reason: 1985: the RWCS 'uses the vertical positioning information supplied by the NEXT GROUP clause along with information from the TYPE and PAGE clauses, and the value in LINE-COUNTER, to determine a new value for LINE-COUNTER'. 2023 states the same: §2023:13.18.37.4 GR2 'The NEXT GROUP clause modifies the value of the current report's LINE-COUNTER after the printing of the last line ... The effect of this clause depends on the type of report group'; GR3 (report heading), GR4 (body group, using LINE-COUNTER and 'the FOOTING integer') and GR5 (page footing) give the per-type computation; §2023:8.4.3.15.4 GR4 and §2023:13.18.35.4 GR8 restate that the final LINE-COUNTER is the one the NEXT GROUP rules define. A pure run-time positioning rule, unchanged in substance.
